name: Kyouiku Shidou ~Yamato Nadeshiko Saisei Keikaku~
original_name: 狂イク指導～大和撫子再生計画～
source:
There is a secret organization. The purpose of it is to train girls and make them modest and obedient. Girls who are regarded as violators are taken to a secret base and sexually assaulted in various ways. It never ends until they change... Target girls this time are a rich wife and a cheeky student.

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
有一个秘密组织。其目的是为了训练女孩子，让她们变得谦虚、听话。被视为违法者的女孩会被带到秘密基地并以各种方式遭受性侵犯。除非她们改变，否则永远不会结束……这次的目标女孩是一个富有的妻子和一个厚脸皮的学生。

[来自工口游戏商店]
